resources.string: Put some time on your calendar to take a walk outside or maybe even take a meeting while you\'re strolling through your neighborhood.
Drink a full glass of water
Drink a full glass of water first thing in the morning to kickstart your hydration and boost your energy levels for the day.
Read 10 pages of a book to expand your mind, learn something new, and take a peaceful break from screen time.
Do a 10-minute stretch session to relieve muscle tension, improve your posture, and enhance your overall flexibility.
Write down three things you are grateful for to cultivate a positive mindset and appreciate the small moments in life.
